meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 先扫描项目,标记未使用的变量、导入、函数和类型;再用 LSP 确认它们确实未被引用;然后并行派多个代理删除,每个改动单独提交,最后运行类型检查与构建来验证。
howto.when: 当你说“remove dead code”“cleanup”或“remove unused”等清理指令时触发。

say.text: 请移除项目中的死代码。
say.note: 会扫描全项目并删除未使用代码。

say.text: 清理 src/utils 目录里没用的代码。
删除未使用的导入和变量。
say.note: 会做 LSP 验证再删。

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unused variables, imports, functions, and types; uses LSP reference checks to confirm they are genuinely unreferenced; then dispatches parallel agents to remove them in separate atomic commits, and runs typecheck and build to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to remove dead code, clean up unused code, or say keywords like "remove dead code", "cleanup", "remove unused".

say_en.text: Please remove dead code from the project.
say_en.note: Scans the whole project and deletes unused code.

say_en.text: Clean up unused code in src/utils.
say_en.note: Scans and removes dead code in that directory only.
